おかわりくんは、なぜこんなに三振できたのか――2166三振と482本塁打のあいだ

Takeya Nakamura has played 2,163 NPB games and struck out 2,166 times as of September 6, 2026. The strikeouts are an all-time NPB record. Yet his 482 home runs rank 10th all time and first among active players. 2011年には48本塁打を放ち、千葉ロッテのチーム本塁打46本まで上回った。This is not a story about why strikeouts are good. It is a story about how success and failure can both become enormous when a player keeps earning another plate appearance.
